note: Sullivan County IN (18153): no county or city zoning district layer is published as a queryable ArcGIS REST or OGC service. The City of Sullivan's zoning district map is a PDF (Jan 2015). The county's open data hub and map viewers list only parcels and community locations; the county ArcGIS REST host did not respond. Commercial parcel vendors (Equator, Rockford, Dynamo) are not official sources. No ArcGIS Online zoning layer for Sullivan County was found.
